title: Stability Cadence Bridge — Cross-Team Integration Plan
summary: Working plan to align platform, SRE, serving-runtime, and product teams on a repeatable cadence for defining, validating, and operating service SLOs. Purpose: reduce onboarding friction for SLO adoption, improve telemetry parity across services, and create clear handoffs for error-budget operations.
goals: 1) Ship a minimal SLO onboarding kit (templates + telemetry checklist) by end of Wave 1. 2) Establish a monthly cadence for SLO review & remediation with clear owners. 3) Reduce time-to-detect for P50->P95 latency regressions by 30% within 90 days after rollout.
milestones: M1 (Week 0–3): SLO kit alpha (template, SLO rationale doc, measurement queries). M2 (Week 4–7): Telemetry parity checks and logging standards for 6 pilot services. M3 (Week 8–12): Alert hygiene sweep + runbook handoff for pilots. M4 (Week 13–20): Cross-team dry run of error-budget policy and cadence. M5 (Week 21–24): Roll to second cohort + retro and acceptance.
timeline: Sprint-based plan starting 2026-03-15. Week numbering used above aligns to two-week sprints. Target pilot cohort kickoff: 2026-03-29. Public rollout to product teams targeted for 2026-07-01.
owners_matrix: Platform engineering: Anika (lead) — SLO templates, rollout coordination; SRE: Marcus — alerting policy, error-budget ops; Serving runtime: Luis — telemetry hooks, perf baselines; Product-hosted-api: Emily — pilot service owner; Observability: Jordan — dashboards and query libraries; Security/compliance: Nina — data access requirements and audit logging.
telemetry_requirements: Minimum signals: p50/p95/p99 latency, success rate (4xx/5xx breakdown), tokens-per-request (for model serving), concurrency, GPU utilization (for Dedicated), cold-start counts. Requirements file will include query examples for DataDog/Prometheus and a mapping to console dashboards. Telemetry parity checklist will be a one-page doc attached to each pilot onboarding.
alerting_policy_outline: Tier 0 (showstopper) — service down / SLO breach predicted within 1 hour; Pager to SRE rotation. Tier 1 (high) — sustained P95 latency > target for 15 min; Slack alert + on-call notification. Tier 2 (info) — trending metric crosswalk (5% degradation) — notify service owner and link to SLO review ticket. All alerts must include playbook link and suggested remediation steps.
rollout_wave_plan: Wave 0 (design): internal trial across platform components. Wave 1 (pilots): 6 services across Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private teams. Wave 2 (expand): 20-30 services (product teams) for baseline coverage. Wave 3 (optimize): integrate Optimize recommendations and quality regression checks into cadence.
communication_and_meetings: Weekly working sync (45m) — core implementers (Platform, SRE, Observability, Serving runtime). Biweekly steering (30m) — EMs + Product leads. Monthly all-hands (60m) during rollout phases for cross-org visibility. Slack channel pinned resources: SLO templates, telemetry checklist, runbook templates.
dependencies_and_risks: Deps: observability query performance (infra), model-serving perf baselines from serving-runtime, secure access to metrics (security/compliance). Risks: inconsistent metric naming across services, alert fatigue if thresholds copied verbatim, delayed instrumenting of legacy services. Mitigations: naming lint checks, alert tuning workshop, phased instrumenting with fallback dashboards.
unresolved_questions_and_next_steps: Q1: Which product teams volunteer for Wave 1 pilots? Action: EMs to nominate by 2026-03-20. Q2: Can Prometheus scrape high-cardinality model traces without cost spike? Action: Observability to run cost estimate by 2026-03-22. Next steps: finalize SLO template v0.2, schedule alerting hygiene workshop, create JIRA epics for each pilot.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Pilot services have SLOs defined, measured, and dashboarded. 2) Alerts map to playbooks and have <2 false-positive rate in 30-day window. 3) On-call runbook handoff completed and sign-off by SRE and service owner.
action_items: - Anika: finalize SLO template and add examples (due 2026-03-18). - Marcus: draft alert-tier definitions and pager rotation proposal (due 2026-03-21). - Luis: instrument GPU/utilization metrics hooks for pilot services (due 2026-03-25). - Emily: identify pilot service owners and share integration constraints (due 2026-03-20). - Jordan: create dashboard prototype and query library (due 2026-03-23).
notes: Notes to self: keep the first SLO template deliberately small — reliability signal + business impact + remediation. Avoid over-automation in Wave 1; prefer manual verification and learning. Capture usage patterns to feed Optimize recommendations later.
